MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "John Denver and Peter, Paul and Mary feel like natural next choices because their melodic folk songs and vocal harmonies connect with my Simon & Garfunkel, Jonathan Edwards, and Melanie listening.",
    "The folk collections match my repeated interest in best-of albums, while Goodbye Yellow Brick Road fits the melodic classic pop and rock I enjoy alongside the Beatles."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "ZZ Top's First Album leans toward blues-heavy rock, whereas I am more interested in vocal melodies and familiar older songs right now.",
    "Chicken Skin Music, Older, and Pain Killer do not give me enough recognition to choose them confidently; my hesitation is uncertainty about the music, rather than a definite dislike.",
    "NOW 60 is not an automatic match just because I listened to Born This Way; I would need to know which songs it includes."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My classic rock listening seems to have been treated as a broad interest in older rock, although the sound and emphasis on melody matter more to me than the era alone.",
    "My interest in compilations seems to have been extended too broadly: a collection appeals when I recognize and want its music, not simply because it gathers hits."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated choices of Simon & Garfunkel, Jonathan Edwards, and Melanie suggest that folk songwriting and expressive vocals deserve more weight in what I hear next.",
    "There is a difference between something fitting my taste and wanting it now: Changes in Latitudes Changes in Attitudes and the Jethro Tull collection have appeal, but I would choose the folk collections first."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in older melodic music and collections, but stretched that interest beyond the familiar folk songs and vocal melodies I most want now."
}
